Junior Willie Williams tackled the first event on the timetable, that laborious race, the 400m. hurdles. And we must not forget Brian Gorman - now making his mark in our veterans' ranks.

Willie Williams was a hat-trick man in the junior events, while old rivals and team-mates John Stow and Bill Curtin shared the 800m. and 1,500m. titles, with John taking the former, and Bill the latter.
In the 110m. hurdles championship, Willie Williams, out junior high jump champion, won his first senior title, with a narrow victory over John Martin, our shot, discus and senior high jump champion.
Mick - already a great asset - also took the junior long-jump, while Willie Williams made a jumping double in the junior events by clearing 1.52m. to win the high jump.
